exclusions.rule: Recorded inspection keys plus every exact response-hash duplicate of recorded exposure
unrecoverable_history: informal snippet exposure without complete key logs
exclusions.freshness: Disjoint from documented prior inspection; historical exposure is incompletely logged

substitution_reference: Human D=S versus response_type=DESCRIBE_SUBSTITUTE; raw substitute flag is used only for sampling changed status
masking: Page includes only opaque IDs, full prompt/response and prompt-imaginary flag

subset.name: core41
subset.rule: Every selected item in a changed stratum, plus, in each populated unchanged stratum, the one selected item with the lowest selection rank (SHA-256 of the frozen selection seed, newline, canonical key).
subset.note: Same audit_id as the parent so labels from either page validate against both.
